title: Workflow steps refuse their own timeout outcome because they demand the success fields
whatHappens: An agent tries to end a stuck workflow step with timeout, and the step refuses because success-only fields are missing.

observations.text: Feedback: 5 reports from 2 agents, 30 Oct 01:26 to 03:54 UTC. Rebind also cannot recover a role while the run waits on a gate.
